Chapter 6832: Torn Asunder

Chapter 6832: Torn Asunder

“What did you do?!” Gluttonous Wolf shot a lunar beam, melting space into nothingness. No minor world could withstand the blast.

Li Qiye only smiled and used his will again. An invisible hand delved into the wolf’s body and ripped the spine out of his body.

“Ahh!” The beam dissipated instantly since the user lost his spine without being able to react.

“Die!” Depravity Abyss was horrified and transformed into a spinning black hole, twisting everything inside.

However, the black hole suddenly stopped to his astonishment.

“Ahhhhh!” His screams were even more horrific than the others’, as if he were enduring an unbearable pain.

He was large enough to engulf this battlefield but Li Qiye’s will tore him apart. Pieces of mangled flesh flew away from the black hole. Even his true fate was being sliced to pieces. Unfortunately, the only thing he could do was scream. This was a worse fate than Absolute.

The defenders were at a loss for words. How could an overlord be so fragile? He resembled a piece of paper being torn apart by a mischievous child.

Dark Emissary was no stranger to death. However, his knees trembled. This wasn’t due to the dismemberment since he had seen crueler battles before. The problem was that his opponent didn’t lift a finger or use any power from start to finish. The guy’s hands were still hanging by his sides.

Nevertheless, this ended with Primal Eagle being pierced by his own feathers, Gluttonous Wolf having his spine ripped out, and Depravity being torn apart in his black hole form.

Dark Emissary fled in the direction of Dark Realm, the only place that might be safe. He was swift and melted into the darkness.

In Stygian, he had complete freedom of movement due to the favorable affinity.

“Where are you going?” However, Li Qiye still appeared before him.

He immediately changed direction and fled.

“Why so nervous?” Li Qiye still blocked his path.

It didn’t matter how many times he changed direction; the man always appeared before him. Worst of all, the pursuer didn’t seem to be moving at all.

Speed and distance were useless. No matter what he did, he seemed to be teleported to the pursuer. He couldn’t make sense of this bizarre occurrence. No other immortals had this ability before.
